note: Remote private lodge campground on the Panther River west of Sundre (about 40-45 minutes from town), reached by ~30 km of gravel road; cell service is limited in the valley and there are no stores nearby. Three loops: A semi-serviced (15-amp power, potable water for tank fill-up and dump access, no sewer at the site; air conditioners will not run on 15 amp), B fully serviced along the river, and C, the newest, with larger premium sites. Gravel pads only, each with picnic table and fire ring; shared gazebo with BBQ, equestrian sites, and a lodge with meals in peak season, cabins and canvas tents. --Claude
summary: Live site blocked (Cloudflare 403); read the operator's May 2026 pages on Wayback and the Cloudbeds engine. Riverfront lead: front row ~15-20 m from a ~20-25 m channel -> creekside for the front row. Google 4.4/158.

Tests: (1) price passes; (2) nightly rates posted plus an online engine - pass; (3) no standing minimum (a possible 2-night minimum on peak weekends/events only); (4) all three loops sell nights - pass; (5) no lots or homes sold. Not mostly seasonal on what the operator shows; a lodge/resort with cabins, tents, trail rides and weddings.

WATERFRONT (stored riverfront -> recommend creekside for the front row, reviewer's call): on Esri imagery (about 0.5 m/px, autumn) the riverside loop at the pin (about 51.6236,-115.3528) has a front row of about five RV pads 15-20 m from the Panther River's wetted channel, across a riprap edge and a grass strip with scattered single spruce (open ground, no road between). The wetted channel there measures about 20-25 m wide (the gravel floodplain upstream is much wider), under the ~30 m riverfront size rule, so the measured value is creekside. The rest of that loop sits 30-80 m back, and the forest loops about 250-450 m SW of the pin are 150 m+ from the water. Which lettered loop is the riverside one is unclear: the operator's camping page says 'Campground B is set directly along the Panther River' ('Fully Serviced Riverfront Sites') while Cloudbeds describes Campground A as 'Nestled in the pines and along the bank of the Panther RIver' and B as 'Located on the west end of the property'. Site numbers of the front row not known.

ROAD: no operator statement about the access road or rig limits found beyond 'Accommodates RV units up to 45 feet'; the FAQ says 'about 40-45 minutes from Sundre'. The stored note's '~30 km of gravel road (passable by a normal vehicle)' is from earlier research, not re-read.
PIN (51.62400,-115.35100): on the riverside RV loop beside the lodge buildings - no move. Google's pin 51.62595,-115.34945 is the lodge, 200 m NE.
EQUESTRIAN: the camping page offers 'equestrian sites with dedicated space for your four-legged companions' as an extra; the RV loops are general campsites, not a horse camp.
